# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `bun run config:docs` from packages/core/src/config/declarations.ts. Do not edit by hand: `bun run check` fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every environment variable Lictory's runtime code reads. The API, the worker,
the collaboration service and the migration runner check their variables when
they start and stop with every problem listed at once; tests fail when code
reads a variable that is not declared. Empty or whitespace-only values count
as unset, so a deployment that forwards every variable still gets the
defaults.

Where to set them: [`.env.example`](../../.env.example) for local development,
[`deploy/env/self-hosted.env.example`](../../deploy/env/self-hosted.env.example)
and [`deploy/compose.production.yaml`](../../deploy/compose.production.yaml) for
a server (Compose maps a few names: `ZERO_API_KEY` becomes both Zero keys,
`APP_HOST` becomes `PLATFORM_URL`). Deployment-only settings (hosts, database
passwords, backups, sizing) are described in those files and in
[deployment](./deployment.md); zero-cache's own `ZERO_*` settings follow
[Rocicorp Zero's documentation](https://zero.rocicorp.dev/docs).

An external or managed PostgreSQL is configured in the server's `.env` with
`LICTORY_DATABASE=external`, `DATABASE_HOST`, `DATABASE_PORT`,
`DATABASE_SSLMODE` and `DATABASE_CA_FILE`; Compose builds every connection
below from them ([external and managed PostgreSQL](./external-database.md)).

## Production rules

With `NODE_ENV=production` (set by the production images):

- Variables marked _In production_ are required.
- A secret must not be a placeholder from an example file or runbook (for
  example `.env.example`'s `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` value, or `generate` left over
  from `deploy/env/*.env.example`).
- Generated secrets need at least 32 bytes. Use `openssl rand -hex 32`.
- Outside production the same checks for missing required values, whole
  numbers, origins and choices apply; secrets are not checked.

Development fallbacks (`BETTER_AUTH_URL`, `localhost` origins) apply only
outside production.

## Delivery credentials key

`DELIVERY_CREDENTIALS_KEY` encrypts stored Jira API tokens. Without it the key
is derived from `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`, which ties rotating one to the other.

- **New installations** must set it before connecting Jira. In production,
  connecting Jira is refused while the key is unset and no delivery
  credentials are stored yet (no `delivery_connection` row exists, including
  archived ones). The rest of Lictory works without it.
- **Existing installations** that already stored credentials with the derived
  key keep working unchanged. The API and the worker log a `config.warning` at
  startup. To decouple the two secrets without re-entering tokens, set
  `DELIVERY_CREDENTIALS_KEY` to the current `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` value (it
  derives the same key); `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` can then rotate on its own.
- Never rotate `DELIVERY_CREDENTIALS_KEY` once credentials are stored: they
  become unreadable and every Jira connection must be reconnected.

## Services

| Service             | What it is                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| api                 | HTTP API (`apps/api`)                                                                                                                          |
| worker              | Background worker (`apps/worker`)                                                                                                              |
| collaboration       | Live draft editing for Lictory Spaces (`apps/collaboration`, behind `/collaboration`)                                                          |
| migrate             | Migration runner (`bun run db:migrate`, the `migrate` image)                                                                                   |
| platform            | Platform SPA build and Vite dev server (`apps/platform`); values are embedded at build time                                                    |
| website             | Marketing website (`apps/marketing`); most values are embedded at build time                                                                   |
| edge-proxy          | Local single-origin proxy for development and browser tests (`scripts/edge-proxy.ts`)                                                          |
| rebuild-projections | Operator script that rebuilds read projections (`scripts/rebuild-projections.ts`)                                                              |
| database            | Database compatibility checks and role setup (`bun run db:compatibility`, `database.mjs` in the migrate image, the `database` Compose service) |

## Runtime

| Variable                | Required | Default                                | Read by                                       | Secret | Description                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NODE_ENV`              | No       | `development`                          | api, worker, collaboration, platform, website | No     | `production` turns on the production rules: required settings, placeholder and length checks for secrets, no development fallbacks. Production images set it. |
| `PORT`                  | No       | `3002` (API), `3120` (Vite dev server) | api, platform                                 | No     | Port the API, or the platform's Vite dev server, listens on.                                                                                                  |
| `HOST`                  | No       | `0.0.0.0`                              | api                                           | No     | Interface the API listens on.                                                                                                                                 |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS`   | No       | `25000`                                | api                                           | No     | How long the API drains requests after SIGTERM before it stops.                                                                                               |
| `PLATFORM_DIST_DIR`     | No       | `apps/platform/dist`                   | api, edge-proxy                               | No     | Directory of the built platform SPA; the API serves its `index.html` as the document.                                                                         |
| `ZERO_SERVER_LOG_LEVEL` | No       | `error`                                | api                                           | No     | Log level of the API's Zero query and mutate handlers. Domain rejections are logged at `warn`.                                                                |

| `DATABASE_ADMIN_URL`      | No                               |                | database                                                           | Yes    | An administrator connection (a role with CREATEROLE and CREATEDB, such as a managed provider's master user) used once by `database.mjs setup` (`lictory database setup`) to create Lictory's roles and databases.
